corpus_row.citation: Deposit/structure: O'Hare K, Alley MR, Cullingford TE, Driver A, Sanderson MJ. 1991. DNA sequence of the Doc retroposon in the white-one mutant of Drosophila melanogaster and of secondary insertions in the phenotypically altered derivatives white-honey and white-eosin. Mol Gen Genet 225(1):17-24 (PMID 1705654) - supports that this record is the sequence of the Doc retroposon itself. Clade: Villasante A, Abad JP, Planello R, Mendez-Lago M, Celniker SE, de Pablos B. 2007. Drosophila telomeric retrotransposons derived from an ancestral element that was recruited to replace telomerase. Genome Res 17(12):1909-1918 (PMID 17989257) - states in its Discussion, in an RT-phylogeny paper on jockey-clade elements, that Dmel\Doc is among 'other members of the jockey clade such as, Dmel\Doc, Dmel\F, Dmel\Juan, and Dmel\X'.
corpus_row.why_safe: Despite the DEFINITION line naming the white locus, the whole deposit is the element: the feature table annotates mobile_element 1..4725 with /mobile_element_type="insertion sequence:Doc retroposon", so no coordinate extraction from a host locus is required. Both ORFs are complete, translated CDSs (ORF1 213..1910 RNA-binding protein; ORF2 1910..4576 reverse transcriptase), giving the canonical two-ORF jockey-clade architecture. The three misc_feature entries in the record were checked individually and mark secondary insertions found in OTHER derivative alleles (I factor in w-IR2, B104 in w-honey, pogo in w-eosin) - they are not disruptions of the white-one Doc copy deposited here, so the intact-autonomous framing holds. Confidence is medium rather than high solely because the Jockey-clade assignment rests on a passing (though peer-reviewed and phylogenetically grounded) Discussion statement in Villasante et al. 2007 rather than a dedicated clade table; the class-level non-LTR LINE call is high confidence from the deposit paper and record structure. Note the terminal misc_feature at 4693..4694 implies the element's 3' end is at or just before ~4692, i.e. the last ~30 bp may be flanking white sequence.

completeness.scope: gag (matrix/capsid/nucleocapsid), protease, RT, RNase H, DDE integrase, envelope, chromodomain, LINE ORF1p and apurinic-like endonuclease, tyrosine recombinase, Helitron helicase, and transposases of the CACTA, hAT, IS4, MULE, Tc1/Mariner and unclassified DDE groups

evidence: RT without a DDE integrase and without LTRs → non-LTR retrotransposon (LINE)
3′ poly-A tail consistent with target-primed reverse transcription
apurinic-like endonuclease N-terminal to the RT in the same reading frame → the ORF2p EN–RT architecture of a LINE
a Penelope-like element would also show RT without a DDE integrase; its GIY-YIG endonuclease is not in the tested panel, so it is not excluded here
4 shorter ORF(s) were outside the profile search's ORF budget and were not searched — a domain listed as not detected was not tested on those
classification.explanation: Classified as LINE (moderate confidence). Structural: poly-A tail.
